findings.source_quote: They received the call ... the wedding was furnished with guests ... all must wear the wedding garment ... an alabaster box ... said to have been worth a year's wages
findings.suggested_fix: Rekebisha sarufi iliyo wazi: “wapi safari hii ingewapelekea” kuwa “safari hii ingewapeleka wapi”; “tunapomchagua kumfuata” kuwa “tunapochagua kumfuata”; “harusi ikajaza wenyealikwa” kuwa “karamu ya harusi ikajaa wageni”; “Nananukuu” kuwa “Ninanukuu”; “Ufalkme” kuwa “Ufalme”; “wote lazima vae” kuwa “wote lazima wavae”; “wakiwa vazi la kuchoka” kuwa “wakiwa wamevaa mavazi chakavu”; “Moja ya tabia” kuwa “Moja ya sifa”; “alikuwa na kukutana na Yesu hapo hapo zamani” kuwa “alikuwa amekutana na Yesu hapo awali”; “liliitwa kuwa lenye thamani” kuwa “lilisemekana kuwa na thamani”; “Alimwagia miguu ya Yesu” kuwa “Aliipaka miguu ya Yesu mafuta”; “amenioga miguu yangu” kuwa “ameiosha miguu yangu”; “Kumfuata Yesu kunatujia uso kwa uso” kuwa “Kumfuata Yesu kunatukutanisha uso kwa uso”; na “hitaji letu hunaita neema Yake” kuwa “hitaji letu hulilia neema Yake”.

Moja ya tabia ... alikuwa na kukutana na Yesu hapo hapo zamani ... liliitwa kuwa lenye thamani ... Alimwagia miguu ya Yesu ... amenioga miguu yangu ...
